reviewer: Separate scientific/architecture review agent within the same development team
independence_limit: Independent implementation review within this development session; not external scientific validation, a witnessed experiment, or an engineering approval.
scope: v0.5 separate nominal-dry bench adapter, immutable calibration/freeze/withheld-response ledger, UI and explicitly synthetic software exercise

fixed_findings.issue: Cross-partition response matching could be bypassed by renaming a sensor ID or changing series order.
fixed_findings.reproduction: Preserve quantity, location, unit, elapsed times and values; rename SENSOR-A. The earlier implementation generated a different response fingerprint.
fixed_findings.fix: Fingerprint sorted semantic quantity/location/unit/time/value content, excluding caller labels. Retain matching receipts as suspected reuse and unresolved; identical values are not proof of reuse.

fixed_findings.issue: Freeze preparation could backdate the freeze to method entry and accept an event that started before preparation finished.
fixed_findings.reproduction: Advance the clock while computing lineage so a declared future event starts before the append. The earlier implementation retained its entry timestamp.
fixed_findings.fix: Read a fresh time after preparation and require each measured assignment to start at least 60 seconds later. The immutable event uses that final timestamp.

fixed_findings.issue: The earlier export skipped nested base/half artifacts and did not validate changed or missing evidence before presenting cached success.
fixed_findings.reproduction: Export a paired run or alter a retained model.inp after calculation. The earlier basename-only export could silently omit pair files or export altered bytes.
fixed_findings.fix: Anchor the accepted manifest hash, verify current adapter identity and complete safe inventory, check each exported byte hash, preserve nested paths, and suppress cached success when verification fails.

fixed_findings.issue: A failed new software exercise could leave the previous successful result visible.
fixed_findings.reproduction: Seed a successful cached exercise, then make the next runner raise an exception.
fixed_findings.fix: Clear the previous current-attempt result before execution and verify stored study integrity before displaying a completed exercise.

fixed_findings.issue: The Water entering metric displayed only applied lateral inflow even when receiving backflow was positive.
fixed_findings.reproduction: The accepted backflow fixture has zero applied inflow and more than 0.01 m3 of receiving-water inflow.
fixed_findings.fix: Show applied inflow and receiving backflow separately.

fixed_findings.issue: A trace labelled prescribed boundary used computed outlet node HEAD, which can differ from a receiving stage below the outlet invert.
fixed_findings.reproduction: Supply a receiver stage below outlet invert; hydraulic outlet head rules can clamp or otherwise alter node HEAD.
fixed_findings.fix: Draw the prescribed boundary trace from receiving_stage_m, and keep internal node responses distinct.
evidence: read-only inspection of _run_view and worker column_roles

verification.project_wide_suite_status: Root stopped an earlier full-suite invocation before a final UI change and retained its log at work/pytest-v05-pre-layout.log in the workspace. Root restarted the full suite under its final freeze; that run is not claimed complete by this review.

established: The software can validate explicit bounded bench contracts, execute isolated real SWMM primary/refined pairs, and retain numerical and provenance diagnostics.
The local ledger can preserve calibration candidates and observation bytes, freeze one declared model/plan, and report later response error summaries without automatically accepting model accuracy.
The UI preserves absent-data and unsupported-state distinctions and labels circular generated examples as synthetic.
not_established: A built rig, authentic survey, calibrated sensors, measured response data, externally witnessed prospectivity, or physical model validation.
Completion of the unchanged 24-event physical protocol, uncertainty-aware acceptance, measured forcing reproduction, or field engineering approval.
A scheduling advantage: the unchanged v0.3 screened policies each abstained on all 10 events and tied no work on all 10; no new policy benefit is tested here.

remaining_scope_limits: Only fixed geometry with nominal dry/zero-flow starts. Wet reset, hotstart and equilibrated-control mechanisms remain unsupported; do not omit or relabel the unsupported frozen protocol rows.
Model predictions use prescribed inflow and receiving-stage curves. Actual measured boundary reproduction is not checked, so response errors can include forcing mismatch.

Every internal compartment needs explicit volume geometry; absorbing node collectors and zero losses are assumptions. Unrepresented lateral escape, surface re-entry, receiving-tank storage and nonzero losses require additional reviewed representation.
Conservation and step refinement establish bounded numerical adequacy only. Fixed numerical floors may hide smaller effects; physical bench scaling and model-form suitability remain unassessed.
Local timestamps, source hashes and append-only records establish local consistency, not an authenticated external clock, observer identity, data authenticity or prospective collection.
Identical semantic response values can be legitimate repeated zero-response runs; matching receipts remain suspected reuse and unresolved, not proof of fraud.
The declared response uncertainty is retained but not used to perform the frozen physical protocol's acceptance assessment.
The demo uses this same solver plus explicit 1 mm calibration and 10 mm withheld offsets. Its known-error arithmetic is circular software verification, not independent hydraulic evidence.

primary_sources_consulted.use: Elapsed swmm_step time is decimal days; final return and routing endpoint behavior.
Minimum numerical surface area is not a measured storage-volume curve.
Maintainer live result conversions; local installed-runtime tests remain necessary.
Maintainer conversion table includes rounded SI volume factor 0.02832; verified against local raw/live results.

next_gate: Root-owned project-wide tests and release integrity checks, followed by prospective physical preparation and data collection under a reviewed supported protocol. This review grants no field-use authorization.
